title: Rite of incubation in the giants' tombs

tellings.quote: those tombs, it's known to the archaeological community, were configured in such a way so that they could accommodate what's called the right of incubation

plain: On the Italian island of Sardinia stand ancient stone burial sites called the giants' tombs. A filmmaker and researcher named Tim Alberino tells podcast host Jesse Michels that archaeologists know these tombs were built to allow the rite of incubation, a ritual of sleeping in a sacred place to receive dreams or visions. He brings it up as a sign that the tombs were places for contact with the dead or the otherworldly.
